pr_title: changefeedccl: revert Dial() to fetch all metadata topics
pr_body:
Patch (https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/114740) changed Dial() in pkg/ccl/changefeedccl/sink_kafka.go to refresh
metadata exclusively for kafkaSink.topics() rather than for all topics. This
triggered a sarama error ( an invalid replication factor in Kafka servers). It
seems hard to get to the bottom of it given that there are too many unknowns
from sarama and kafka side (More in https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/116872). We decided to revert back to what
Dial() previously did in sarama code and will continue investigating afterwards.

Part of: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/116872
Fixes: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/116358
Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/116414)

I think with the current approach where we manually call RefreshMetadata with empty topics, it fetches all topics since we are passing an empty argument. RefreshMetadata doesn't check for `config.Metadata.Full=false` ; the check is done before RefreshMetadata is called. The current approach is mocking the behaviour as if `config.Metadata.Full` is set to true https://github.com/IBM/sarama/blob/4d31d23ca31a68788d4249cfc8f44e619cea2d3a/client.go#L217-L226.

I'm okay with the current implementation. To be safe, I would prefer to always have `config.Metadata.Full=false`.
Ack.
